title: estdif / w3fdif deinterlace selector — integration contract
purpose: A concrete adapter that makes the shared and divergent interfaces of FFmpeg estdif and w3fdif explicit, so a caller can select or switch between them with a single decision table. Covers mode/parity shared surface, estdif-only tuning knobs, w3fdif-only coefficient switch, and the frame-rate side-effect of w3fdif mode=field.
